findings.summary: The 2% inflation figure is hidden behind a button. The main screen only says 'in today's money'. This is about how visible the figure is, not a button that does nothing.
Small grey text on a dark background is hard to read even when enlarged, especially the explanations under the numbers.
The cost chart uses colours that look alike, so the reader had to check the small legend to identify the pink part.
The fund list is crowded with English letters, coloured labels and red minus amounts, and it made the reader anxious.
The input layout jumped sideways after typing in the first box. Listed problem 2 is the result cards jumping up and down because of a note.
Nothing near the result says the 7% growth isn't guaranteed or that the money could fall, which could lead to a wrong decision.
